hypothesis: Visualization improvements — new plot types for trajectory comparison, wildcard impact, and agent activity
ceo_rationale: Visualization package (3 new plot types) is fully implemented, tested (103 tests, 8 new), and addresses critical analytical need for multi-run simulation data. Heatmap-based plots enable pattern discovery that raw logs cannot provide. Clean lint, <500ms render time for N=50 runs, publication-quality PNG output.
learned: Heatmap-based visualizations (trajectory comparison, wildcard impact, agent activity) are essential for understanding multi-run simulation behavior at scale — raw logs and CSVs are uninterpretable for N>10 runs.
anti_patterns: Do not export raw trajectory data expecting users to analyze manually (use visual analytics for pattern detection)
Do not use line plots for N>5 trajectories (heatmaps or scatter with density are necessary)

playbook_proposals.content: For batch simulation frameworks, add visualization layer early (heatmaps + correlation plots for N trajectories, renders in <500ms)
Publish simulation results with heatmap analytics (trajectory clustering, wildcard correlation, agent activity) — raw data exports are not actionable for stakeholders
